about: All 55 trophies with their official PlayStation names, descriptions and grades. Every guide is broken into cited steps: each step is one claim, and the sources beside it are where the claim comes from. Citation counts shown in the app are computed from this file. Missable flags and the roadmap order are derived from the official descriptions.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is awarded automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt: work the roadmap stage by stage and keep an eye on the missable flags in stages 2 and 3, because a missed one-off moment is the only thing that can force a second playthrough. Your last unlocks will almost certainly be A Long Road (100% completion) and one of the big counters, so check the tracker before the finale and sweep what is left.

steps.t: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate objective for it.
The official list it completes holds 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze.
The other 54 break down as 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze trophies.
The only thing that can force a second playthrough is a missed one-off trophy: five trophies in this guide are flagged missable from their descriptions.
Expect the last unlocks to be A Long Road (100% completion) and one of the large counters, so sweep those before the finale.
Listing check: a platinum trophy worth 300 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission of the campaign, so this unlocks simply by playing the first minutes of the story and finishing the introductory job. It cannot be missed: the campaign cannot advance past it, and the chapter trophies that follow all build on this start.

steps.t: Requirement: complete Gone Fishing, the opening mission of the campaign.
It unlocks in the first minutes of the story, by finishing the introductory job.
Because it is the first mission, the campaign cannot advance past it — this trophy cannot be missed.
It is the first of the chapter trophies: completing it starts the run toward Paradise Lost (Chapter 1).
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission that makes up Chapter 1 of the story, starting with Gone Fishing. Chapter trophies are structural — the next chapter only opens when the current one is done — so this is earned on any full story playthrough with no detours required.

steps.t: Requirement: complete Chapter 1 of the story.

Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Beat the campaign's final mission after Chapter 4. Before you start it, sweep the flagged one-off trophies in this roadmap (Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck, I Guess and Personal Best sit in the same endgame stretch): the finale is the point of no return for anything tied to story choices, while free-roam content stays open afterwards for the 100% push.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the final mission of the campaign.
It is one of only two gold trophies on the list.
Before starting the finale, sweep the flagged one-off trophies in the endgame stretch — Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck, I Guess and Personal Best sit in the same part of the list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is one of the named story missions, and this trophy is its completion stamp. Play the campaign in order and it unlocks when the mission ends; named-mission trophies like this one double as a checklist of how far through the story you are.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the story mission Breakfast Run.
It is one of six named-mission trophies in the campaign's middle chapters.
There is no extra condition beyond finishing the mission, and it cannot be bypassed on the way to the finale.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the story mission Child's Play.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, the last of the named story missions before the endgame. Completion in the campaign is the whole requirement; after this one, only the final mission stands between you and the gold story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach a full 100% on the game's completion counter. In this series the counter is a weighted checklist — story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed it — so the practical route is to finish everything else in this guide first and then use the in-game completion screen to find the last missing items. It is deliberately placed in the final roadmap stage: almost every other trophy is a down payment on it.

steps.t: Requirement: attain 100% completion on the game's completion counter.
It is one of only two gold trophies on the list.
The completion counter is fed by story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration — nearly every other trophy is a down payment on it.
Use the in-game completion screen at the end to find the last missing items rather than guessing.
Listing check: a gold trophy worth 90 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the stunt jumps scattered across Leonida. Work them region by region whenever you pass a ramp rather than saving them all for the end, and use a fast, durable vehicle you can replace cheaply — failed landings do not count, only clean completed stunts do. The counter is large but every stunt stays available, so nothing here can be missed.

steps.t: Requirement: complete 250 stunts.
PlayStation tracks this trophy with a counter to 250 — the count tracker above keeps your running total.
Failed landings do not count — only clean, completed stunts advance the counter.
Work stunts region by region as you pass ramps instead of saving all 250 for the end.
Use a fast, durable vehicle you can replace cheaply for the attempts.
Every stunt stays available all game, so nothing here can be missed.
Listing check: a silver trophy worth 30 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once: races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games, meditation spots and the rest of the map's activity icons. You only need to start each type, not win it, so a single free-roam session touring the icons earns this — and it doubles as a tour of what the other activity trophies will ask you to master.

steps.t: Requirement: try each type of activity once.
The game offers 9 activity types to sample — the count tracker above tallies the types you have tried.
The activity types include races, drone races, the shooting range, fishing, arcade games and meditation spots.
You only need to start each type, not win it.
The nine types are the same activity icons the other activity trophies ask you to master, so this doubles as a tour of them.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge — the published list tracks 42 of them across the ranges of Leonida. Learn one range's target patterns at a time and replay immediately while the layout is fresh; accuracy medals usually reward a slower, fully-aimed run over a fast spray. Challenges can be retried without limit, so this is a skill gate, never a missable.

steps.t: Requirement: earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
The published list tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count tracker above tallies your golds.
A silver medal is not enough — every one of the 42 must be gold.
Learn one range's target patterns at a time and replay immediately while the layout is fresh.
Accuracy medals usually reward a slower, fully-aimed run over a fast spray.
Challenges can be retried without limit, so this is a skill gate, never a missable.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at each of its locations around the map — a win at every site is required, not just a finish. Run a sighting lap first to learn each course's gates, then race it properly; the courses stay available all game, so clear them city by city as you explore.

steps.t: Requirement: win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
There are 14 Top Fun locations to win at — the count tracker above tallies them.
A finish is not enough — each location needs a win.
Run a sighting lap first to learn each course's gates, then race it properly.
The courses stay available all game, so clear them city by city as you explore.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeat wins on the same track do not add to the count, so keep moving to fresh race icons. Start with the shortest street races to build the number quickly, and bring a tuned car you own rather than a borrowed one so the handling is predictable from race to race.

steps.t: Requirement: win 20 different races.
Repeat wins on the same track do not add to the count — the 20 must be different races.
Start with the shortest street races to build the number quickly.
Bring a tuned car you own rather than a borrowed one, so the handling is predictable from race to race.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in one of his fishing challenges. Fishing challenges are offered by Cal as a repeatable activity, so learn the cast-and-reel timing on a practice round first, then challenge him once you can land fish reliably. Losing costs nothing but time — challenge him again until you win.

steps.t: Requirement: beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
Cal's fishing challenges are a repeatable activity, so a loss costs nothing but time.
Learn the cast-and-reel timing on a practice round before challenging him.
Challenge him again until you win — there is no limit on attempts.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play one of the arcade cabinets found in Leonida's bars and arcades through to completion — finishing a single arcade game is enough, not beating every cabinet. Pick the shortest game on offer if several are available; this also ticks the arcade type off Master of None.

steps.t: Requirement: complete an arcade game.
Finishing a single arcade game is enough — you do not need to beat every cabinet.
Arcade cabinets are found in Leonida's bars and arcades.
Pick the shortest game on offer if several are available.
This also ticks the arcade type off Master of None's nine activity types.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's stranger strand all the way to its final mission and finish it. Stranger strands unlock in stages as you meet each character and return later, so start Andy's strand early and check the map for his icon whenever a new mission appears — strands count toward the Strangers & Freaks total of eight as well as the 100% counter.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the final mission for Andy.
Andy's is a stranger strand: a chain of missions that unlocks in stages as you meet him and return later.
The trophy pops only on the strand's final mission, not the first job.
Start the strand early and check the map for his icon whenever a new mission appears.
Andy's strand is one of the eight strands counted by Strangers & Freaks, and strands feed the 100% counter too.
Listing check: a bronze trophy worth 15 PSN points — Exophase and PSNProfiles publish the same name, description and grade for it.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand through its final mission. As with the other named strangers (Andy, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), the strand is a chain: each completed job unlocks the next after some in-game time passes, so if Kenton's icon vanishes, advance the story or sleep and it will return.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Fully complete eight stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The named strands with their own finale trophies — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — are five of the eight, so finish those first and then complete any three further strands you meet. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so track chains, not first meetings.

steps.t: Requirement: complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
PlayStation tracks this trophy with a counter to 8 — the count tracker above tallies finished strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand through its final mission. Keep the strand moving whenever Randy's icon is on the map — strand missions often gate the next step behind a delivery or a wait, and leaving them half-done is the usual reason this trophy feels stuck.

steps.t: Requirement: complete the final mission for Randy.

trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's stranger strand to its final mission. Together with Andy, Kenton, Billy and Randy, Tyrone's strand is one of the five named strands; clearing all five leaves only three more strands needed for the silver Strangers & Freaks trophy.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Visit every meditation spot in Leonida and meditate at each one. Treat the spots as a collectible set: sweep them county by county and tick them off in this tracker as you go, because the game gives no partial trophy — only the final spot triggers it. Meditation spots also count as an activity type for Master of None.

steps.t: Requirement: meditate at every spot across Leonida.

The game gives no partial trophy — only the final spot triggers it.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting job and bring down the unique animal he sends you after. Unique animals are one-off hunts tied to Bret's strand rather than the ordinary wildlife, so follow his lead to the hunting ground and track the specific animal he names; ordinary kills do not substitute.

trophies.guide: Assemble three complete sets of the collectible cards hidden around Leonida. Cards are found one at a time in the world, so grab every card you spot while doing other content and check the collection screen to see which sets are closest to done — finishing the three shortest sets is far quicker than completing the whole deck.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's Challenges. Challenges are the short tracked objectives the game lists per activity and skill, so open the challenges screen, sort by the ones closest to completion, and mop those up first — most players cross 50 naturally by finishing the activity trophies in this roadmap.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While travelling with your partner (the other protagonist), raise a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely with them still beside you. Deliberately earn the stars somewhere with an easy escape — near tunnels, alleys or a vehicle swap — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars drain. It is repeatable in free roam, so a failed escape just means trying again.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob three shops in one unbroken wanted sequence — the wanted level must never fully clear between shops. Pick a tight cluster of shops, keep a fast car outside each one, and move straight to the next target while the stars are still up; losing the heat or splitting up resets the chain.

Work through traffic variety deliberately: richer districts spawn sports cars, industrial areas spawn trucks and utility vehicles, and marinas and airfields cover boats and aircraft. Swap cars often instead of living in one favourite and the counter climbs fast.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: During one activation of Combat Focus, drop five enemies before the effect ends. Set the moment up: trigger a fight against a grouped patrol or gang spot, line the enemies up first, then activate Focus and work left to right with a high-capacity weapon. If a run falls short, any crowded firefight gives you another attempt — nothing about it is one-time.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a series in-joke: the Rhino is the tank. Get into a Rhino tank — they appear at military installations and at high wanted levels — and the trophy is tied to taking one for a spin. Expect heavy resistance stealing one from a base, so bring armour and an escape plan; once you are in the seat, you are the danger.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected — no alarm, no wanted level. Scout the store first, enter quietly, keep the staff controlled without firing a shot, and leave on foot to a discreet vehicle rather than screeching away. Jewelry stores can be robbed again, so a blown attempt only costs a retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape the police after each one — a robbery only counts when you get away, not when you are caught or killed holding the money. Space the five out so you can bank the cash and reset between jobs, and stage a fast, plain car a block away from each bank for the getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck in free roam, take the cash and escape the wanted level. Armored trucks run delivery routes around the map; block one with a heavy vehicle, deal with the guards quickly, and break the rear doors rather than wasting time on the cab. One successful truck-and-escape is all it takes.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover the whole map of Leonida, the state Vice City sits in. Exploration registers by area, so the last few percent are always the far corners: island chains, swamp interiors and the northern border country. Finish the story first — some areas open up as the campaign expands — then do a deliberate border-to-border sweep by air to catch whatever is left fogged.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

Gang operations sit in gang territory, so learn each gang's turf from the map and your story progress, rob one operation in each, and expect the owning gang to defend it. Keep a list in this tracker: the trophy gives no partial credit until every gang has been hit.

Showrooms stay open in free roam, so if the first attempt ends in a wall, walk back in and take another car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin

The bowling name suggests a group: line up a cluster of pedestrians on a pavement, ride past at moderate speed (too fast and you just run them over, which is a different animation), and sweep the whole group in one pass. Any busy pavement works and it is endlessly repeatable.

Marked bills come from robberies and scores; instead of spending dirty cash as it arrives, route it through the laundering contacts whenever you are carrying some, and the total will accumulate across the whole playthrough. It pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal and the other robbery trophies in stage 7.

If you are short at the end, buying and upgrading one expensive vehicle closes the gap in a single transaction.

notes.t: The campaign opens with Gone Fishing, the first story mission.
Chapter 1 completes inside this stage, earning Paradise Lost.
In The Beginning… is flagged missable: its description points to an early Ocean Beach moment.
Chapters 2, 3 and 4 each carry their own completion trophy.
Six named missions sit in this block: Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory.
Catch Me If You Can is flagged at VCIA, the airport, during this block.
The final mission carries one of the list's two gold trophies.
Actions Speak Louder is tied by its description to story choices.
Bad Luck, I Guess and Personal Best are flagged from their descriptions as one-off endgame moments.
Five named strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each end in a finale trophy.
Strangers & Freaks asks for 8 completed strands in total.
Bret's unique-animal hunt, Fair Game, sits in this block.
Don't Touch My Deck asks for 3 complete Collectible Card sets.
You WAiNKer! tracks 100 locations and Whip It Good 100 discovered vehicles.
Positive Mental Attitude covers 18 meditation spots, and The Goodtime State all 52 areas of Leonida.
Cunning Stunts tracks 250 stunts; The Shootist asks for gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Top Fun covers drone races at 14 locations, and Earn Cash, Not Kudos 20 different race wins.
The money milestones live here: $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles registered.
Maximum Withdrawal tracks 5 bank vaults robbed and escaped.
Pest Control asks for one illegal operation robbed from each of the 9 gangs.
The partner feats — Hot Together and Retail Therapy — need the other protagonist beside you.
A Long Road asks for 100% completion, the list's second gold.
Almost every other trophy feeds the completion counter.
Vice Got a Price!, the platinum, lands automatically when the other 54 are earned.
